summary.zh: 开发与修复后端接口和服务
summary.en: Build and repair backend services and APIs

description.zh: 覆盖 REST 与 GraphQL 接口、鉴权、微服务、PostgreSQL 查询与迁移，以及压测。适合接口变慢或出错、需要加登录鉴权、改表结构，或起一个新服务的时候使用。
description.en: Handles REST and GraphQL endpoints, auth, microservices, PostgreSQL queries and migrations, plus load tests. Reaches for it when an API is slow or broken, login needs adding, or a schema change and new service are due.
